# GPT-6 Astra: Vognary Total Product Experience Rebuild

This is the founder's September 6, 2026 design reset. Select GPT-6 Astra in the host application's model picker if that exact model is available. A prompt cannot select an unavailable model, and the agent must not claim that another model ran. This file intentionally does not hard-code an unverified model identifier.

## 1. The Commission

I reject the current visual result. Reconstruct Vognary's entire public website and operating product into one original, memorable, exceptionally usable experience. The current palette, typography, page structure, component shapes, navigation, copy hierarchy, visual scores, and previous designer decisions have no presumption of survival.

The standard is the coherence, immediate comprehension, response quality, and repeated-use ease people expect from excellent Apple and Google products, with the originality and craft of exceptional Awwwards work. Those are standards to learn from, not layouts to copy or claims that Vognary has earned an award, valuation, or customer love.

Act as the accountable creative director, product designer, interaction designer, motion designer, frontend engineer, and integration owner. Exercise taste. Make consequential design decisions. Build the result, inspect it in a browser, repair it, and leave a usable experience. Do not hand me a mood board, another critique, a color replacement, a landing-page-only makeover, or a static prototype presented as a product.

Design from an empty artboard, not an empty understanding of the product. You may replace the presentation architecture. You must understand the financial and persistence contracts before touching their consumers.

I am not asking for an imitation of a large company. I am asking for a small product with professional completeness: clear purpose, excellent composition, dependable controls, no fake success, no dead ends, and quality that survives the first real task.

## 2. Authority and Ownership

This mandate supersedes older founder restrictions on visual identity, incumbent selection, art direction, presentation-only scope freezes, and named previous frontend owners for this candidate. Read [AGENTS](../../AGENTS.md), [THE-LAW](../../docs/THE-LAW.md), and the newest [live handoff](../../docs/CONTINUE-HERE.md) for product truth, actual environment state, and coordination. Do not interpret an older rejected appearance as a design requirement.

Before edits, establish one active integration owner and confirm no overlapping frontend writer is running. Preserve dirty work from all sessions. Stay in the authorized checkout; no destructive reset, sibling clone, or removal of another owner's work.

You may reconstruct navigation, route composition, information architecture, interaction patterns, styling, tokens, type, iconography, imagery, motion, frontend adapters, presentation state and frontend tests. Remove replaced presentation code after checking its consumers. Vognary's name and the meaning of actual product operations remain intact.

Bounded repairs needed to make an existing action truthful and usable belong in the work: unknown-save feedback, input validation, data-retention disclosure, pagination, record URLs, focus and retry handling. Trace their owning abstraction and add the appropriate regression. This is not authorization for a new payment rail, autonomous agent, connector, financial formula, destructive migration or unrelated backend rewrite. If a new protected contract is truly required, name the precise dependency and seek that scope decision while continuing independent frontend work.

The founder has requested Git publication and a live Vercel result. Use the verified linked repository/project, commit the complete intended candidate, and release the exact verified revision through the existing controlled process when the applicable gates permit it. Do not enable unconditional automatic deployment as a shortcut. A publication request is not evidence that release gates, customer-data clearance, or unseen visual acceptance have passed.

Never fabricate an approval, credential, test run, customer reaction, payment, assessment, or deployment. Never interpret creative freedom as permission to weaken security, privacy, human authority, exact money, or evidence requirements.

## 3. The Product to Make Effortless

Read the current [Phase B loop](../../docs/execution/phase-b-loop-shipping.md). The primary person is a finance owner or authorized administrator at an India-first AI-native company, deciding an obligation before it is created and checking what happened later.

The irreducible experience is:

```text
Recognize the obligation needing attention
  -> identify the proposed amount and intended outcome
  -> inspect cited exposure, assumptions, unknowns and policy
  -> record an explicit authorized human decision
  -> preserve the actor, cap, expiry and decision context
  -> attach later observed evidence by explicit human selection
  -> understand the exact verdict and next action
  -> return to the same trustworthy record
```

Every screen must serve one exact moment, one primary action, and an observable completion state. Do not make users understand the repository's module names to operate the business workflow.

Financial facts cite evidence; proposals and user-entered outcomes are labelled assumptions or observations. Unknown is not zero. A policy assessment is not authorization. A recorded cap is not technical enforcement. Scheduled charges are not observed payments. No automatic purchase, approval, decline, provisioning, cancellation, receipt matching, or money movement is implied by a label or animation.

Use exact minor units and explicit currencies throughout. Preserve role checks, immutable decisions, tenant boundaries, concurrency controls, and idempotency. The one-time INR 14,999 pilot month is not an automatically renewing subscription; recheck the current offer before rendering it.

A public demonstration may be beautifully designed and explicitly synthetic. A customer's saved workspace must use real handlers and durable records. Never fill a production workspace with examples to make it appear successful.

## 4. Taste Research That Leads to a Decision

Use actual browser inspection of [Awwwards](https://www.awwwards.com/) and the linked destination sites, including their phone behavior and interactions. Also inspect accessible Apple and Google product experiences and a strong information-dense work tool. Gallery thumbnails are not evidence of interaction quality.

Choose a small, varied reference set. Extract principles for composition, hierarchy, typography, interaction response, transitions, forms and density. Record each URL, inspection date, useful principle, and what would be inappropriate for Vognary. Report blocked access honestly and use accessible alternatives.

Stop researching once you can defend a direction. Consider genuinely different directions on the same populated decision task, choose one, and implement it without a prolonged concept-voting exercise. Do not copy branded layouts, copyrighted illustration, source, or distinctive animation sequences.

Load the installed [frontend design](../../.claude/skills/frontend-design/SKILL.md), [React best practices](../../.claude/skills/vercel-react-best-practices/SKILL.md), [browser testing](../../.claude/skills/webapp-testing/SKILL.md), and [Next documentation](../skills/next16-docs/SKILL.md) guidance. Discover useful MCP/browser/image tools through the actual tool registry; do not invent availability.

Use compatible, maintained and licensed libraries when they earn their cost. Prefer the smallest appropriate accessible primitive or motion tool over redundant frameworks. Paid services, new external accounts, invasive plugins and private-data transfer require explicit permission. A library is a means, not a design direction.

## 5. One Recognizable Visual Identity

Write a short design thesis describing what Vognary should feel like, what the user notices first, and the signature detail that helps them understand a decision. Then make the public site, workspace, sign-in, account and documents feel like one company.

Character can come from precise proportions, typography, evidence treatment, the approval-to-outcome comparison, or a memorable transition. It does not require a mascot, 3D, visual noise, or an expensive motion stack.

Choose a purposeful display face and a readable interface/data face. Define a disciplined rem-based type scale, semantic color pairs, spacing, grid, surfaces, focus treatment, icons and motion tokens. Keep letter spacing at zero and preserve exact readable numerals. Distinguish brand color from financial status; meaning must not depend on color alone.

Do not settle for interchangeable rounded cards, ornamental KPI tiles, purple gradients, generic dark dashboards, beige stationery, glass panels, or a tasteful recolor of the rejected candidate. Page sections should be unframed layouts or bands, not nested cards. Use cards only where an actual repeated item or framed tool needs one.

Use original or properly licensed visual assets that reveal the real product or a clearly labelled synthetic state. No fake customers, testimonials, savings, integrations, awards, certification badges, usage counters, fabricated charts, or anonymous stock-office imagery.

## 6. The First Impression Must Lead Somewhere Real

The first viewport must visibly identify Vognary, make the actual product legible, and offer a meaningful next action. A slogan, preloader or abstract scene cannot be the entire experience. Give a visitor a clear sense of what they can decide here and why the record matters.

If a landing surface is appropriate, make the H1 the brand or a literal category, use supporting copy for the value proposition, and reveal useful product content and a continuation cue across desktop and phone. Do not default to generic text beside a decorative dashboard card.

Do not hide sign-in, the actual product, or honest pilot availability behind experimental navigation. Make the public-to-workspace transition accurate: evidence intake, enrollment, sign-in and live authorization are different steps. A user must not discover only after uploading a bill that the promised task is unavailable.

Give commercial, support, security, privacy and legal pages the same clarity and finishing quality. An invoice link is not proof of payment collection. A security page is not evidence of assessment. The website must never claim more than the actual deployment provides.

## 7. Rebuild the Whole Operating Experience

Inventory current routes and their supported roles/states once. Do not reuse an obsolete route count. For each route, preserve its actual purpose, redesign it, consolidate it with a valid destination, or explicitly record a blocker.

| Surface | Required quality |
| --- | --- |
| Attention and selected record | Recognizable object, material facts and next action immediately visible; no wall of repeated panels |
| Proposal intake | Minimal repetition, exact amounts, appropriate inputs, preserved drafts and useful field validation |
| Policy and exposure | Evidence, assumptions, missing sources and deterministic policy distinct and understandable |
| Human decision | Named obligation, precise cap/expiry/consequence, explicit confirmation and safe cancellation |
| Frozen record | Actor and history preserved; no conflicting duplicates of money or status |
| Evidence and reconciliation | Reach the exact receipt, including paginated history; deliberate selection; clear outcome and return path |
| Exceptions and outcomes | Action follows identity and context; cost evidence never masquerades as business-outcome proof |
| Account and people | Real roles, invitations, workspace changes, settings, support, export and deletion paths |
| Public entry and sign-in | Clear purpose and availability; no deceptive sample workspace or broken enrollment expectation |
| Failure states | Understandable offline, forbidden, expired session, validation, conflict, retry and unknown-save states |

On phone, design the task deliberately rather than stacking desktop components. Selected merchant, relevant amount, current status and next action need priority over generic guidance. Bottom navigation, sticky actions and keyboards must never cover evidence or controls.

Keep secondary material progressively disclosed, not missing. Long histories, long names, large exact values, unusual currencies, empty data and partial evidence must look intentional. Do not truncate away material financial facts.

Use native, familiar control semantics. Icon-only tools need names and tooltips where useful; financial values need precise text inputs, not approximate sliders. Every visible control needs implemented default, focus, selected, disabled, pending and failure states where applicable.

## 8. Close Known Broken Paths, Not Just Their Appearance

Reproduce these September 5 findings against the current tree before repair. They are not optional cosmetic cleanup:

1. A post-commit response loss can produce "Nothing was sent." Represent the outcome as unknown, preserve the original request/key, and recover the authoritative state without duplication.
2. Guest intake says nothing is saved but stores raw receipt text in session storage. Explain processing and tab retention before submission, provide discard, and honor the current customer-data assurance boundary.
3. Programmatic focus after creating a proposal leaves the previous record in the URL. Make selection, history, reload, copied links and Back agree.
4. A reconciliation candidate beyond the first 50 receipts cannot be selected. Preserve pagination or retrieve the exact candidate through an authorized contract, with no automatic selection.
5. The guest audit endpoint dereferences a JSON null envelope and returns 500. Use bounded runtime validation at the owning boundary without altering financial interpretation.
6. Multiple follow-up panels push the selected identity/cap below the phone viewport. Put the facts needed for the decision before the action.

Consult the [review record in the handoff](../../docs/CONTINUE-HERE.md). Do not erase findings by replacing their tests, hiding the controls, changing thresholds, or moving all work to a synthetic page. If a finding has already been repaired by another owner, preserve and validate that repair.

## 9. Motion with Purpose and Craft

Build a small coherent motion language: immediate control feedback, stable selected-object identity, meaningful state changes, and one or two expressive public moments if they improve the design. The working desk should feel responsive, not performative.

Use CSS, Web Animations or progressive enhancement for simple transitions. A specialized library is welcome when a real interaction justifies its payload and complexity. Keep nonessential effects out of the authenticated path. Measure; do not guess.

No scroll hijacking, compulsory intro, fake loading, animated invented financial totals, custom cursor dependence, or constant movement beside reading and decision work. A person may interrupt transitions and continue. Respect reduced motion on the first render and pause unnecessary offscreen work.

If 3D genuinely communicates the product better, use Three.js with a semantic/static fallback. Prove that the scene is visible, correctly framed and interactive using screenshots and canvas checks. Do not add it merely because the brief is ambitious.

## 10. Engineering and Data Quality Are Part of Design

Read the relevant installed Next.js 16 documentation before App Router changes. Keep the canonical workspace and existing server-owned fact sources. Server work stays server-side; client boundaries should earn their cost through actual interactivity.

Replace obsolete frontend abstractions when useful, but keep public API and authentication meanings intact. Prefer existing validators, money formatters, transport contracts and tested primitives over handwritten substitutes. Use runtime validation at untrusted boundaries.

A button is complete only when its full state transition works: authorization, validation, submit, success or uncertainty, recovery, persistence and return focus. A durable success cannot be a transient toast alone. A rejected fetch cannot establish that a write never happened.

Use route-scoped styles and loading boundaries. Keep global CSS genuinely shared. Remove superseded selectors only after checking runtime-built classes and shared consumers. Read actual bundle/inline-CSS budgets rather than copying numbers from old notes.

Use synthetic isolated data for design work. Do not copy production secrets into local servers, run destructive migrations, weaken enrollment, or bypass assessment to make a preview appear real. Do not publish ignored runtime/configuration files.

## 11. Build First, Then Consolidate Verification

Do not repeat a full audit before implementation or run the entire matrix after every small change. The founder wants the experience to exist, then to be finished and verified.

1. Confirm ownership, live state and one real task; gather only enough evidence to choose the first change.
2. Choose the direction and implement a complete operating slice through real handlers, not just its hero or tokens.
3. Immediately run the smallest check that can falsify the changed behavior; repair that slice before expanding.
4. Carry the system through the remaining public/product/account states, inspecting actual desktop and phone screenshots yourself.
5. Once implementation is coherent, run one consolidated required gate and browser matrix on a fixed candidate. Fix concrete failures and rerun the affected checks; repeat broader gates only when their inputs change.
6. Publish and deploy only the verified intended revision through the controlled release path. Verify the public result rather than stopping at a successful upload command.

Keep updates concise and specific. Do not ask the founder to choose every font or approve every component. Do not stall in endless research, repeated testing, self-scoring, or a new master plan.

## 12. Acceptance Evidence

Verify the supported desktop/phone compositions, 320-pixel equivalent reflow, short screens, touch targets, zoom, keyboard, focus, contrast, reduced motion, and actual reading order. Meet WCAG 2.2 AA within the offered scope; Axe is a useful check, not a conformance certificate.

Trace the primary path against real local handlers and a disposable database: sign-in, policy, proposal, explicit owner/admin decision, cap/expiry, saved record, evidence intake, explicit receipt, reconciliation, reload and another authorized session. Use mocks for bounded error states and label them as such.

Maintain a concise action matrix distinguishing verified, intentionally unavailable, blocked and untested. Include role denial, stale state, duplicate submission, response loss after commit, unsupported input, missing evidence, expired authorization, empty/long records, draft recovery, pagination and cross-view navigation.

Inspect screenshots, console errors, missing assets, hydration, collisions and interaction traces. The complete public site and workspace must share the chosen identity. A screenshot of login does not count as a tested authenticated page.

Use the [gate-chain skill](../skills/gate-chain/SKILL.md) and actual CI workflow. Keep all budgets and test requirements intact. Separate current exact-tree results, historical results, production observations and unrun checks. No skipped primary task may be described as finished.

Visual excellence is judged by rendered work and people, not an agent awarding itself 10/10. Confirm what users can now find, understand and complete with less effort. Do not claim a target-user study, founder acceptance or universal affection unless it actually happened.

## 13. Git and Vercel Completion

At handoff creation, the latest published candidate was `9f5518a6de7d8c876bd459508b25a16675ad2c5f`, and [its CI run](https://github.com/varunteja0/Vognary/actions/runs/34017871819) failed. Recheck current Git and CI; do not rely on this historical state. The existing main auto-deployment guard means a push alone does not update production.

Inspect the verified Vercel project, target environment, current aliases, deployed revision, pending builds and rollback target. Never deploy to a guessed project or accidentally publish a developer-login server. No production migration or customer enrollment is implicit in this frontend mandate.

Once applicable release checks pass, commit the intended tracked source and prompt/handoff, push to the intended branch, and perform a controlled Vercel deployment or promotion of that exact revision under the founder's release instruction. Preserve safeguards and the former working deployment for rollback. Do not change DNS, paid plans, keys or broad auto-deploy policy incidentally.

After deployment, verify the actual public hostname, expected revision, key routes/assets, identity and unavailable states, and the primary permitted workflow. Check for stale caches and service-worker interference. Report the public URL and revision, not merely a localhost link, Git push, build log or preview screenshot.

If credentials, CI, assurance, policy or platform access genuinely blocks release, complete independent implementation work, identify the precise blocker and human action, and provide a verified local or appropriately isolated preview. Do not expose uncleared data intake or call a blocked release live.

## 14. Deliverables

Deliver one coherent result:

- The fully implemented public website and authenticated operating product, with no primary workflow left as a design placeholder.
- A short explanation of the original visual character and the concrete usability improvements.
- A working local preview during development and the verified public URL/revision after an authorized successful release, or an explicit release blocker.
- Desktop/phone evidence showing the actual product, including difficult and empty/error states.
- A truthful action matrix, exact gate results, remaining defects, and dependency/asset license provenance.
- A concise current handoff, not another stack of speculative company plans.

Begin with the actual state and the first user's decision. Make a bold original product, not an expensive-looking disguise for unfinished behavior. Keep implementing until the scoped experience is complete or a precise external blocker remains. Do not promise zero defects or a billion-dollar outcome; make the quality visible and the claims provable.
